name: BSN Prelicensure — Fall Entry
sourceWorkbook: UNC Wilmington School of Nursing: what Patricia Suplee and Melissa Scott told the owner on 2026-10-28 (sequences confirmed, class sizes 70 now and 80 from Fall 2027, ABSN 24, NSG 302 as med-surg, the first five weeks in the lab); the prelicensure BSN and ABSN plans of study (four semesters from Fall 2023), course credit splits from the UNCW catalogue, the admission pages (120 a year, fall and spring cycles; ABSN once a year for summer), the 2026–27 registrar calendar, the NC Board of Nursing approved-programs list and the school's accreditation page — compiled 2026-10-28
maxCohortNote: Class size 80 — the planned state, at the owner's choice to model what is coming: the program told the owner on 2026-10-28 that BSN cohorts were 60, are 70 now (Fall 2026 and Spring 2027) and go to 80 from Fall 2027, the spring entry "the same pattern" (its own step to 80 read as Spring 2028). Growth adds clinical sections; didactic courses stay one section until the faculty decide between co-teaching and whole-course loads. The Board's approved maximum is on the NC BON list.
weeklyHoursNote: Hours: a lecture credit is 15 contact hours a semester and a lab or clinical credit 45 — the university's own semester totals (135 clinical/lab hours in semester 1, 180 in each later one; 675 in all) read exactly so. The weekly figures are the semester's hours over its instructional weeks (15 in fall and spring, 10 in the ABSN's summers); no section days, times or rooms are published, so every session carries its hours with no day or time.
